item.description:
Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 417)

Board AI

  • Attach images and files: Cmd+V a screenshot or a file copied in Finder, drop files on the chat, or click the paperclip. Up to 6 files (4 images); text and PDF files up to 64 KB.
  • Cmd+L on the Board puts the cursor in the Board AI input.
  • Attach cards to a message: drop a card on the chat, or type @.
  • Chat history stays after an automatic restart. New chat always works.

Work Board

  • Task cards: one workspace can have several cards, one per task.
  • Sessions report their state more exactly: done means all the work is merged.
  • A card no longer goes to Done while its session keeps working after a merge.
  • Move to Trash and Close Tabs on a card.
  • New boards start with Backlog, In Progress, Need Human and Done.
  • New Project filter. Lists grow wider on big screens.

Settings Sync (new)

  • Keep your settings the same across your Macs with iCloud. Off by default. Privacy choices, repositories, sessions, chats and sign-ins never sync.

Other

  • A YouTube Music tab loads at launch, so the music player works right away.
  • Clear messages when Board AI or Quick AI hits a usage limit.
  • Settings > Appearance: turn off the working or question border animation.
  • New installs open links in your default browser.
